name: Hövej (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of white, yellow and white in the ratio 1:1:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hövej (a green shield with a white flower, ears of grain, a crescent and a star) above the name Hövej in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
